tei:div.tei:p: lhan thabs bzhugs so: : EMBED Photoshop.Image.7 \s rigs kyi mkha' 'gro lnga la phyag 'tshal lo: rigs ldan skyes bu gang la ni: mkha' 'gro snying tig ti ka yi: dbang bskur lam du 'jug pa ni: klong gsal nyi ma'i rgyud dag nas: skal ldan smin byed dbang bskur ba: spros bcas dang ni spros med dang : shin tu yongs su spros med kyis: skal pa ldan pa smin par bya: zhes pas bum dbang bskur thabs logs na yod: 'dir ni chags can 'jug pa'i phyir: gsang dbang man chad bskur ba'i thabs: o rgyan pad+ma bdag gis bstan: las can cig dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dkyil 'khor sta ེ gas bu mthar rdzogs nas: cho ga'i rim pa ma nor bar: bum pa'i dbang nyid tshar rjes su: dkyil 'khor de yi lho phyogs su: dus ni srod kyi dus dag tu: bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga bshams la: ngag sgrib dag nas nus ldan phyir: gsang ba'i dbang nyid bskur bya ste: bla ma mtshan nyid ldan pa la: slob ma mtshan nyid ldan pa las: phyag bya rin chen maṇ+ḍal 'bul: gsang ba'i dbang gi phyag rgya mo: mtshan dang ldan pa'i rig ma la: khrus byas spos dang rgyan gyis gdags: bla ma dag la 'bul ba ni: kye ma ho: khyed ni bde ba che: bde chen pad+ma he ru ka: bder gshegs rnams kyi bde chen yab: bde ba'i dbang phyug bde stsol mdzad: byang chub sems can gang dag don: rnam dag mchog gi yang dag pa'i: dri med bdud rtsi dam pa yis: bla med mchog gi dbang bskur ltar: de bzhin rigs kyi bu dag la: 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal kun bsal mdzod: dri med bde chen bdud rtsi yis: ma rig nyes pa'i dri ma 'joms: bla med byang chub bde chen nyid: dus 'dir bdag gis thob mdzod cig: ces brjod bla ma dag la 'bul: de ltar gsol ba btab rjes la: bla mas mngon par rtogs pa bsgom: gsol ba btab cing mchod bstod bya: de nas slob ma dag la ni: dar ram ras kyis gdong pa bcings:

lag tu me tog thogs nas ni: bskor ba dang ni phyag gsum ni: bla ma yab yum gnyis la 'bul: de nas bla mas slob ma la: ye shes dag ni dbab byas te: bla ma'i mdun tu slob ma ni: langs te rkang pa'i long bu gshibs: gus pas thal mo snying khar sbyar: de nas bla mas ting 'dzin slob: kye ma rigs kyi bu khyod nyon: rang nyid sangs rgyas ḍāk+ki ma: rdo rje phag mor gsal bar bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i lte ba ru: chos 'byung dmar po sum brtsegs bsgom: de yi lte bar phag mo ni: shin tu chung ba gsal bar bsgom: de ltar dmigs pa drag tu gtad: gsol gdab byin dbab rol mo dkrol: 'phar 'khrab bde gsal nyams skye ste: bde stong dbyer med dad de la: ma yengs pa ru bsgom du gzhug: de nas gdong g.yogs bkrol byas la: bum dbang dus su bstan pa ni: rdul tshod dag gi dkyil 'khor yin: de ni dpe yi mtshon bya ste: rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yin: ye nas rang lus dkyil 'khor ru: gnas pa ngo yang sprad par bya: 'khor lo lnga ru rigs lnga yi: sangs rgyas yab yum lnga gnas pa: phung po khams dang skye mched kun: lha yi da lar ngo yang sprad: ces pas: 'o rigs kyi bu khyod gson cig: phyi bum pa'i dbang gi dus su rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas: dpes mtshon bya ru ngo sprad pa yin gyis don dam par byas par song na: rang gi lus 'di rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por bzhugs pa yin te: klong gsal nyi ma'i rgyud las: 'byung ba'i dngas ma las grub pa'i: lus ni bder gshegs pho brang nyid: rigs lnga yab yum lnga yig gnas: phung khams skye mched lha yi sku: zhes pas: rang gi rig pa 'di ni: thog mar 'khor 'das gang du yang ma grub pa'i sngon rol nas: stong gsal bde ba chen por bzhugs te: de nyid rang ngo rang gis ma shes pas: rang rig 'byung bzhi'i sbugs su tshud pa'i lus 'di: sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bzhugs gnas yin te:

spyi bor bde chen gyi tsakra na rdo rje ḍāk+ki yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs: mgrin pa longs spyod kyi tsakra na rin chen ḍāk+ki yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs: snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo na sangs rgyas ḍāk+ki yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs: lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo na pad+ma ḍāk+ki yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs: gsang gnas bde chen tsakra na las kyi ḍāk+ki yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs pa yin no: phung po thams cad dpa' bo: khams thams cad dpa' mo'i rang bzhin yin no: tha ma ba spu'i khung bu yan chad lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pa yin te: lus 'di dkyil 'khor gyi rtsigs pa: bu ga thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi sgo: skra dang ba spu thams cad me ri'i 'phreng ba'o: de yang klong gsal las: 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas zhing : 'khor lo lnga ni rigs lnga'i gnas: phung khams thams cad lha tshogs nyid: sems ni ye shes chen po nyid: lus kyi dkyil 'khor chen po ste: bu ga skra ni sgo dang me: zhes so: de la sogs pa rgyas par ni: rgyud gzhan dag kyang spro bar bya'o: gsang dbang gi lhan thabs so: a+thi+-i: (la) med gzhung du tshang yod/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (5)mkha' 'gro snying thig gsang dbang gi lhan thabs/ - PAGE 210 -- PAGE 209 -- PAGE 207 -
